definition: Source makes target possible or materially unlocks it.
Source cannot reasonably function at claimed scope without target.
Source/evidence checks or supports the target claim/capability.
Source relies on target as an input, substrate or infrastructure dependency.
Idea/project is attributed to a person, institution or program.
Project/activity receives funding from target. Only use with explicit funding evidence.
Source directly outputs target or an instance of the target class.
Source measurably lowers resource/cost burden of target.
Source measurably or structurally expands target capability.
Source and target are alternative approaches to materially overlapping objectives.
Source provides evidence inconsistent with target claim.
Source creates or materially raises a risk to target.
Source constrains, audits, authorizes or sets rules for target.
